pages.title: Retrocausal Ore
pages.text: Ore that knows when it is going to be mined. The vein grows brighter before my pick arrives, and splinters along lines that only make sense once the strike has happened. Holding it feels like being remembered.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)White holes run time backwards. Mining the ejecta rock, I noticed this ore cracking a moment before I struck it. The effect preceded the cause, and the cause still happened.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the white hole interior (mine it for its drop).
